description: This file contains test helper functions and classes for certificate chain validation, including reading test data, parsing certificates, and verifying errors, primarily used in testing the certificate validation code in Chromium.

classes.name: VerifyCertChainTest
classes.description: A class representing a test case for verifying certificate chains, including policies and expected errors.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Extracts a value from a line with a specific prefix, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: OidToString
methods.description: Converts an OID to its dotted string form or hex on error.

methods.name: StrSetToString
methods.description: Converts a set of strings to a comma-separated string.

methods.name: StripString
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing spaces from a string view.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string view by commas and trims spaces.

methods.name: PrintTo
methods.description: Outputs a DER Input as a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: SequenceValueFromString
methods.description: Parses a DER sequence from a string.

methods.name: ReadTestDataFromPemFile
methods.description: Reads PEM blocks from a file and matches them to expected mappings.

methods.name: ReadCertChainFromFile
methods.description: Reads a chain of certificates from a PEM file.

methods.name: ReadCertFromFile
methods.description: Reads a single certificate from a PEM file.

methods.name: ReadVerifyCertChainTestFromFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a test case for certificate chain verification from a file.

methods.name: ReadTestFileToString
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a test data file into a string.

methods.name: VerifyCertPathErrors
methods.description: Compares expected and actual certificate path errors and reports mismatches.

methods.name: VerifyCertErrors
methods.description: Compares expected and actual certificate errors and reports mismatches.

methods.name: VerifyUserConstrainedPolicySet
methods.description: Verifies that the actual user-constrained policy set matches the expected set.
